comparison.declared_treatment: OPERATOR-AUTHORED EXAMPLES, not learner work: A is the compact prompt repair; B is schema guidance plus structural validation. Prompts also differ, so this compares exact repair packages rather than isolating validation. Both request enable_thinking=false under the same model, token and deadline ceilings. No retry, fallback, code-only path or tuning. Recorded S44 inspection is the source, not fresh execution.
comparison.eligibility_reason: No winner is derived here. Candidate eligibility requires a complete comparable outcome, and selection is a separate learner action.

repetition_summary.limits: Small sample: 6 public requests planned for 3 repetitions per version. Retained counts show what completed. Results cover these versions and conditions; any model evidence covers one configured model. Even 9 of 9 passing batches does not establish general reliability. Protected checks remain separate.
